{{Quote|The ''Intercessor'' is the pride of the Republic fleet. The capital ship defended Bothawui and survived the Battle of Hoth; now we will destroy it.|Imperial Fleet mission briefing|<ref name="Vondoru" />}}
The '''''Intercessor''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that participated in multiple battles during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''Intercessor'' was part of the Republic fleet that defended [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[First Battle of Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]], and it was one of the few ships that escaped the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] intact [[3665 BBY|six years later]]. However, the ''Intercessor'' was damaged by an Imperial ambush above [[Vondoru]] over two decades later when the [[Galactic War]] broke out in [[3642 BBY]], and the elite [[Empire's Fury]] squadron [[Battle of Vondoru|destroyed]] the ''Valor''-class cruiser and its reinforcements not long afterwards.

==Characteristics==
A hump-backed [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]],<ref name="Vondoru" /> the ''Intercessor'' was over 500 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="Annihilation" /> With three primary and four secondary engines on a tower protruding from the lower hull and a command tower situated atop the upper hull. The ''Intercessor'' possessed several hangars along its sides,<ref name="Vondoru" /> where it originally stored a complement of 110 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]&mdash;including [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]]&mdash;25 [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], and 40 bombers.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
The ''Intercessor'' was built sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3671 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> That year, the ''Intercessor'' served in the [[First Battle of Bothawui]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Vondoru" /> Six years after<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] victory at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the ''Intercessor'' was part<ref name="Vondoru" /> of a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] detachment assigned to guard a [[Prototype warship fleet|fleet]] of prototype warships that were preparing for an attack on the Empire's capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Gnost" /> When the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was ambushed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], the ''Intercessor'' survived the days-long battle and was one of the few ships to escape the final stages of the battle over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Vondoru" />

The ship remained in service of the Navy for the next two decades through the rest of the Great Galactic War and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Vondoru" /> until the [[Galactic War]] broke out in [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Annihilation" /> That year, the ship was ambushed by the Imperial Navy above the planet [[Vondoru]], and three [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] engaged the ''Intercessor'' and its escort of three [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. The damaged ''Intercessor'' was set upon by the elite [[Empire's Fury]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] and then destroyed.<ref name="Vondoru" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Intercessor'' first appeared in "Clouds of Vondoru", a level 44 fourth-tier space combat mission for the Imperial faction in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission's introduction indicates it served in both the Battle of Bothawui and the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="Vondoru" /> though this must refer to the first battle at Bothawui because the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second]] was a ground battle.<ref name="Gnost" /> The mission can be undertaken by any class, so this article assumes only that it was one of the four Imperial classes.<ref name="Vondoru" />
